text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The autumn Tenno Sho, where Oguri Cap will to go head-to-head with Tamamo Cross, has arrived.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Determined not to lose, Tamamo Cross fires right back at Oguri Cap's declaration of war.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the beginning of the race just moments away, both of them are excited and eager to run.
